TS 解析又被 PowerShell 里的 `$()` 干扰。改用 Node 脚本：

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const urls = [
 "https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2091908429409433289",
 "https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2016559505983448378",
 "https://podscan.fm/podcasts/ai-zao-fu-xian-chang/episodes/ai-zao-fu-xian-chang-di53qi-si-ge-da-si-xue-sheng-zai-su-she-kai-le-yi-jiaai-jian-li-zhen-suo",
 "https://m.163.com/dy/article/KL13GRCM0556KB9F.html",
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "let i=0;",
 "function next(){",
 " if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",
 " const u=cfg.urls[i++];",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/131'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){",
 " let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
 " b=b.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
 " b=b.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34));",
 " b=b.replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
 " console.log('===== '+u+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
 " console.log(b.substring(0,4500));",
 " next();",
 " });",
 " }).on('error',function(e){console.log('===== '+u+' ERR '+e.message);next();});",
 "}",
 "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-p1.cjs", content: js });
console.log("script written");
", "description": "Write Node fetch script for four articles"}

tool_input.code:
const urls = [
  "https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2091908429409433289",
  "https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/2016559505983448378",
  "https://podscan.fm/podcasts/ai-zao-fu-xian-chang/episodes/ai-zao-fu-xian-chang-di53qi-si-ge-da-si-xue-sheng-zai-su-she-kai-le-yi-jiaai-jian-li-zhen-suo",
  "https://m.163.com/dy/article/KL13GRCM0556KB9F.html",
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "let i=0;",
  "function next(){",
  "  if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",
  "  const u=cfg.urls[i++];",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/131'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){",
  "      let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "      b=b.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
  "      b=b.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34));",
  "      b=b.replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "      console.log('===== '+u+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
  "      console.log(b.substring(0,4500));",
  "      next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',function(e){console.log('===== '+u+' ERR '+e.message);next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-p1.cjs", content: js });
console.log("script written");
